definition: The floor of the tone scale: how close the darkest values sit to true black.

not_the_same_as.vec_key_to_fill_ratio: Ratio changes the lights. Black level lifts or sets the floor on the same lighting.
not_the_same_as.vec_shadow_density: Shadow density is how heavy the shadow masses feel, not only the black floor.
not_the_same_as.vec_veiling_glare: Glare is a lens haze. Black lift is a tone-floor change without a required veil.

open_questions: Is the still-life high too weak to keep this as a working axis?

prompt_phrases.high: lifted milky black floor, raised darkest values, no new fill light, no atmospheric haze
prompt_phrases.low: true dense black floor, no milk, no fog, no raised floor

scoring_guidance: 0.00 true black floor, 0.50 natural, 1.00 strongly lifted milky floor. High is lift, not crush.
testable_claim: Raising black level lifts the floor without necessarily opening mid-shadows the same way.
